packs.name: Backyard BBQ & Smoker Pack
packs.description: Low-and-slow smoker and grill favorites with exact pitmaster measurements.

recipes.name: Smoked Pulled Pork Shoulder
recipes.description: Classic low-and-slow hardwood smoked pork shoulder rubbed with brown sugar and paprika, finished with a tangy apple cider vinegar mop.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Pile high on toasted buns or serve over baked sweet potatoes.
ingredients: Pork Shoulder — 4 to 5 lb (2kg) bone-in or boneless pork butt
Brown Sugar — 1/4 cup (50g) packed brown sugar
Paprika — 2 tbsp smoked paprika + 1 tbsp garlic powder
Salt — 1 1/2 tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp coarse black pepper
Apple Cider Vinegar — 1/2 cup (120ml) apple cider vinegar for spritzing & finishing
instructions: Dry Rub: Combine brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, kosher salt, and black pepper. Massage thoroughly over all sides of the pork shoulder.
Smoke at 225°F: Preheat smoker to 225°F (107°C) with apple, hickory, or oak wood. Smoke uncovered for 5 hours, spritzing with apple cider vinegar every hour after the first 3 hours.
Wrap & Finish: Wrap tightly in foil or butcher paper and continue cooking at 250°F (121°C) for 2–3 hours until internal temperature reaches 203°F (95°C) and a probe slides in like warm butter.
Rest & Pull: Rest wrapped for 45–60 minutes, shred with two forks, and toss with the remaining splash of apple cider vinegar and pan juices.

recipes.name: Hardwood-Smoked Garlic Butter Chicken Breasts
recipes.description: Sweet hardwood smoke kisses seasoned chicken breasts before they finish in a warm garlic-butter pan bath that locks in moisture.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Slice warm over rice or cube leftovers for smoked chicken quesadillas.
ingredients: Chicken Breast — 2 large chicken breasts (8–10 oz / 250–300g each)
Butter — 3 tbsp (45g) unsalted butter
Garlic — 2 cloves minced garlic + 1 tsp garlic powder
Paprika — 1 tsp smoked paprika + 3/4 tsp kosher salt & black pepper
instructions: Smoke: Preheat smoker to 225°F (107°C). Coat chicken breasts with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper, and smoke directly on the grates for 45 minutes.

Butter Bath: Melt 3 tbsp butter and minced garlic in a small foil or cast-iron pan on the smoker. Transfer chicken to the butter pan, turn to coat, and smoke 20–25 minutes more until internal temp hits 162°F (72°C). Rest 5 minutes before slicing.

packs.name: Sous Vide & Steakhouse Pack
packs.description: Precision water-bath recipes for edge-to-edge tenderness and cast-iron searing.

recipes.name: Sous Vide Edge-to-Edge Juicy Garlic Butter Chicken Breast
recipes.description: Water-bath cooking at 149°F transforms chicken breast into impossibly juicy meat, finished with a 60-second cast-iron butter sear.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Pour the savory bag juices into the skillet after searing and swirl in an extra tablespoon of butter for an instant pan jus.
ingredients: Chicken Breast — 2 large boneless breasts (8–10 oz / 250–300g each)
Butter — 2 tbsp (30g) unsalted butter, divided (1 tbsp in bag + 1 tbsp for sear)
Garlic — 2 cloves garlic, smashed
Salt — 3/4 tsp kosher salt + 1/4 tsp black pepper
instructions: Preheat Water Bath: Set your sous vide circulator to 149°F (65°C).
Bag & Cook: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, seal in a vacuum or zip-top bag with 1 tbsp butter and smashed garlic, and cook submerged for 1.5 hours.

Dry & Flash Sear: Remove chicken from the bag and pat completely dry with paper towels. Melt the remaining 1 tbsp butter in a smoking-hot cast-iron skillet over high heat and sear 60 seconds per side until golden brown.

recipes.name: Sous Vide Steakhouse Ribeye with Roasted Garlic Butter
recipes.description: Thick steak cooked edge-to-edge medium-rare in a precision bath, then crusted in a blazing skillet with foaming garlic butter.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Add a sprig of fresh rosemary or thyme to the bag before sealing.
ingredients: Steak — 2 thick ribeye or strip steaks (10–12 oz / 300g each, 1.5-inch thick)
Butter — 3 tbsp (45g) unsalted butter, divided
Garlic — 4 cloves garlic, lightly crushed
Salt — 1 tsp kosher salt + 1/2 tsp coarse black pepper
instructions: Sous Vide Bath: Preheat water bath to 132°F (55.5°C). Season steaks generously, seal in a bag with 1 tbsp butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves, and cook for 2 hours.

Cast-Iron Sear: Remove steaks and pat bone-dry with paper towels. Heat a cast-iron skillet until smoking, add 2 tbsp butter and remaining garlic, and sear steaks 60 seconds per side while basting continuously.

packs.name: Holiday Side Dishes
packs.description: Classic family sides and casseroles with exact measurements.

recipes.name: Velvety Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Fluffy boiled potatoes whipped with warm milk, plenty of melted butter, and sweet sauteed garlic.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Fold in 1/2 cup shredded cheddar or 2 tbsp sour cream for loaded mashed potatoes.
ingredients: Potatoes — 2 lbs (900g) Yukon Gold or Russet potatoes, peeled and quartered
Butter — 4 tbsp (60g) unsalted butter, melted
Milk — 1/2 cup (120ml) warm whole milk or heavy cream
Garlic — 3 cloves garlic, finely minced and sautéed in butter
Salt — 1 tsp kosher salt + black pepper to taste
instructions: Boil Potatoes: Place peeled, quartered potatoes in a pot of cold salted water. Bring to a boil and simmer 15–18 minutes until fork-tender, then drain thoroughly.
Infuse Butter: In a small pan, melt the 4 tbsp butter over low heat and gently cook the minced garlic for 1 minute until fragrant (do not brown).
Mash: Mash the hot potatoes while slowly folding in the warm milk and garlic butter until smooth and creamy.

recipes.name: Golden Scalloped Potatoes in Cheddar Cream Sauce
recipes.description: Thinly sliced potatoes layered with sweet onions and baked in a rich garlic-cheddar cream sauce until bubbling.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Layer diced ham or crumbled bacon between the potato slices to turn it into a main dish.
ingredients: Potatoes — 4 medium potatoes (700g), thinly sliced into 1/8-inch (3mm) rounds
Onions — 1 small onion (100g), thinly sliced into rings
Cheddar Cheese — 1 cup (115g) shredded sharp cheddar cheese, divided
Milk — 1 3/4 cups (420ml) warm milk
Butter — 3 tbsp (45g) unsalted butter + 2 tbsp flour
Garlic — 2 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: Make Cheese Sauce: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Melt 3 tbsp butter over medium heat, sauté garlic 30 seconds, whisk in 2 tbsp flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in 1 3/4 cups warm milk until thickened. Stir in half the cheddar.

Layer & Bake: Layer sliced potatoes and onions in a greased baking dish, pour the warm sauce over top, cover with foil, and bake 35 minutes. Uncover, top with remaining cheddar, and bake 20 minutes more until tender and golden.

recipes.name: Creamy Garlic Tuscan Chicken Thighs
recipes.description: Crispy golden chicken thighs simmered in a velvety garlic, parmesan, and spinach cream sauce.
recipes.mixAndMatch: Swap chicken thighs for chicken breast steaks, pork chops, or shrimp.
ingredients: Chicken Thighs — 1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs
Butter — 2 tbsp (30g) unsalted butter
Garlic — 4 cloves garlic, finely minced
Heavy Cream — 1 cup (240ml) heavy cream + 1/2 cup (120ml) chicken broth
Parmesan Cheese — 1/2 cup (50g) freshly grated parmesan
Spinach — 2 cups (60g) fresh baby spinach
instructions: Sear Chicken: Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper. Sear in 2 tbsp melted butter over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes per side until golden brown (165°F / 74°C). Set aside.
Build Sauce: Sauté minced garlic in the pan drippings for 30 seconds. Whisk in chicken broth and heavy cream, simmering for 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Finish: Stir in grated parmesan and fresh spinach until wilted, then return chicken to the pan to coat in the sauce.
